The full map lives in ROUTING.md and loads automatically at the start of every Claude session.

Without it

  • ×You name the tool every timeThe agent rarely picks the right skill by itself.
  • ×Plugins installed blindNobody read the hooks that now run on your machine.
  • ×Answers as chat wallsResearch ends up as long text nobody shares.
  • ×Setup per computerEvery new machine starts from zero.

With makkov-harness

  • →The map picks the skillSay what you need; routing does the rest.
  • →Every plugin reviewed and pinnedExact commits, verdicts in SECURITY.md.
  • →Results as designed pagesReports you can send to a founder as is.
  • →Install once, works everywhereDesktop, terminal and cloud sessions.
